class.name: OcgTransferFinder
class.brief_description: a Finder allows to map any kind of object as a Key for a Map. This works by defining, for a Hash Code, that of the real Key, not of the Finder which acts only as an intermediate. When a Map asks for the HashCode of a Finder, this one returns the code it has determined at creation time
class.description: ! a Finder allows to map any kind of object as a Key for a Map. ! This works by defining, for a Hash Code, that of the real Key, ! not of the Finder which acts only as an intermediate. ! When a Map asks for the HashCode of a Finder, this one returns ! the code it has determined at creation time

method.name: GetHashCode
method.description: Returns the HashCode which has been stored by SetHashCode (remark that HashCode could be deferred then be defined by sub-classes, the result is the same)

method.name: ValueType
method.description: Returns the Type of the Value. By default, returns the DynamicType of <me>, but can be redefined

method.name: ValueTypeName
method.description: Returns the name of the Type of the Value. Default is name of ValueType, unless it is for a non-handled object

method.name: SetAttribute
method.description: Adds an attribute with a given name (replaces the former one with the same name if already exists)

method.name: RemoveAttribute
method.description: Removes an attribute Returns True when done, False if this attribute did not exist

method.name: GetAttribute
method.description: Returns an attribute from its name, filtered by a type If no attribute has this name, or if it is not kind of this type, <val> is Null and returned value is False Else, it is True

method.name: Attribute
method.description: Returns an attribute from its name. Null Handle if not recorded (whatever Transient, Integer, Real ...)

method.name: SetIntegerAttribute
method.description: Adds an integer value for an attribute

method.name: GetIntegerAttribute
method.description: Returns an attribute from its name, as integer If no attribute has this name, or not an integer, <val> is 0 and returned value is False Else, it is True

method.name: IntegerAttribute
method.description: Returns an integer attribute from its name. 0 if not recorded

method.name: SetRealAttribute
method.description: Adds a real value for an attribute

method.name: GetRealAttribute
method.description: Returns an attribute from its name, as real If no attribute has this name, or not a real <val> is 0.0 and returned value is False Else, it is True

method.name: RealAttribute
method.description: Returns a real attribute from its name. 0.0 if not recorded

method.name: SetStringAttribute
method.description: Adds a String value for an attribute

method.name: StringAttribute
method.description: Returns a String attribute from its name. "" if not recorded

method.name: SameAttributes
method.description: Gets the list of attributes from <other>, as such, i.e. not copied : attributes are shared, any attribute edited, added, or removed in <other> is also in <me> and vice versa The former list of attributes of <me> is dropped

method.name: GetAttributes
method.description: Gets the list of attributes from <other>, by copying it By default, considers all the attributes from <other> If <fromname> is given, considers only the attributes with name beginning by <fromname>
